name: Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Flash
access: QwenCloud speech synthesis API: WebSocket (DashScope SDKs for Python, Java, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS) and HTTP under the same model name, and AOQ; Singapore and China North 2 (Beijing) regions [qwencloud-tts-models] [qwencloud-tts-guide] [qwencloud-tts-access]

voice.input_audio: None for synthesis: the model takes text, with optional inline emotion and nonverbal tags and optional SSML (enable_ssml); a voice-cloning clip is WAV (16-bit), MP3 or M4A, 10 to 20 seconds advised, at most 60 seconds and 10 MB, at 16 kHz or more [qwencloud-tts-guide] [qwencloud-tts-events] [qwencloud-voice-cloning]
voice.output_audio: pcm, wav, mp3 (default) or opus; 8000, 16000, 22050 (default), 24000, 44100 or 48000 Hz; bit_rate 6 to 510 kbps for mp3 and opus; volume 0 to 100 (default 50), rate and pitch 0.5 to 2.0 (default 1.0) [qwencloud-tts-events]
voice.voices: 139 system voice IDs in the qwen-audio-3.1-tts-flash voice list: 4 multilingual and dialect, 15 premium English and 51 additional-language voices in Singapore and China North 2 (Beijing), and 42 premium Chinese and 27 additional system voices only in China North 2 (Beijing); plus cloned voices and designed voices [qwencloud-tts-voices] [qwencloud-tts-models]
languages: System voices: Chinese (Mandarin) and English, by voice, per the overview; the voice list adds 4 multilingual voices that also speak 8 Chinese dialects and Japanese, Korean, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Vietnamese and Indonesian, and one voice for each of the 51 additional languages; some voices take a dialect instruction [qwencloud-tts-models] [qwencloud-tts-voices]

Cloned voices: Chinese (Mandarin and 20 dialects), English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, French, German, Portuguese, Thai, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Spanish, Italian, Malaysian, Filipino and Arabic [qwencloud-tts-models]
51 more languages and variants listed for this model only, among them Dutch, Hindi, Polish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Swahili, Mexican Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese [qwencloud-tts-models]
voice.turn_detection: Not applicable; a synthesis model does not listen
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model; finish-task with directive cancel stops the running synthesis, and the connection can then start a new task [qwencloud-tts-guide] [qwencloud-tts-events]
voice.session_limit: 20,000 characters per continue-task message and 200,000 characters per task; the gap between messages must not exceed 23 seconds; a connection closes 60 seconds after a task ends if no new task starts [qwencloud-tts-events] [qwencloud-tts-guide]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: QwenCloud price list, international deployment: US$0.23 input and US$1.87 output per million tokens; this is the one Qwen-Audio TTS model billed by tokens, the others bill input characters. Mainland China: US$0.212 and US$1.696. Free quota 1,000,000 tokens. Model page rate limit 180 requests per minute [qwencloud-prices] [qwencloud-page-tts31flash]
